test_pulsar_depth_rendering: test the PULSAR renderer depth map output against a reference depth map on CUDA and CPU
run_renderer_forward_with_depth: run the PULSAR Renderer forward pass with min_depth and max_depth parameters to render spheres
extract_depth_map_from_result_info: extract a depth map from the renderer result info using depth_map_from_result_info_nograd
create_pulsar_renderer: create a PULSAR Renderer with orthogonal projection and configurable image width, height, and max points
visualize_depth_map_as_image: visualize a depth map as a normalized uint8 image and save it with imageio
